evals.prompt: Review this landing page for live polls (Page.html). It is checked at 1440, 768 and 375 px with no horizontal scroll, and the images are the DS placeholder until screenshots land. The section CSS (sections.css) is each DS Marketing section's CSS pasted unchanged; only the <style> block in the page is the builder's own.
evals.label: good-control
evals.notes: Good control: the reference page, a Vivid Pink hero then a white and pale pink body. Guards against over-firing on a page assembled exactly from the sections.
evals.expected_output: Every band is a DS Marketing section with shipped spacing and widths; the hero is the Hero Pink header (Vivid Pink with the Darker Pink Splash, white heading, white button) with one H1 and the Footer banner repeating Get started free; after it the body alternates white (Logos), pale pink (Features), white (Testimonials), pale pink (icon grid), white (FAQ), so no two coloured bands touch, and the only other Vivid Pink band is the footer banner, after a white FAQ (two Vivid Pink bands in all); placeholder images with alt text and registry icons; Navigation with <aha-product-lockup>; motion only from the DS motion script. Headings are centred over every full-width section and each content section ends with its shipped centred call to action row: Read customer stories under Testimonials, Read the docs under the FAQ and Sign up everywhere else; testimonial authors are left aligned. Overall: OK TO SHIP.
assertions: Overall verdict is OK TO SHIP
